# Story 11.2: Pin the Electron app to a stable default origin (fixed port)

Status: in-progress

## Story

As a user (Dave),
I want my sort/filter preferences, theme, remember-me choice, and login session to still be there when I reopen the desktop app,
so that I don't have to re-authenticate and re-configure every time I relaunch.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. The startup port resolution in `apps/electron/src/main.ts` (`main.ts:285-290`) is changed so that when no override is set it uses a **fixed default port constant** (e.g. `7420`, which collides with none of the ports already in use — 3000, 4200, 4566, 8080) instead of calling `findAvailablePort()`. Every launch therefore loads the same origin `http://localhost:<fixed-port>`, so cookies (AD-5 auth cookie) and localStorage (sort/filter/theme/remember-me) are saved to and retrieved from the same origin across launches.
2. If the fixed default port is already in use by another process at startup, the app falls back to `findAvailablePort()` for that launch only — a degraded but non-crashing path — so the app still starts rather than failing to bind.
3. When `DMS_SMOKE_PORT` is set in the environment, the app uses that override exactly as before (`parseSmokePort`, `main.ts:232`) — smoke-test behavior is unchanged and takes precedence over the fixed default.
4. Story 11.1's red-phase unit assertions (AC #1/#2 there) are unskipped and pass under `nx test electron` with no pre-existing regression in the Electron specs, and the CSP (`configureContentSecurityPolicy`) and navigation guards that read `port` continue to work against the fixed origin.

## Dev Notes

- **Root cause:** `apps/electron/src/main.ts:289` calls `findAvailablePort()` on every launch; `main.ts:207` then loads `http://localhost:${port}`. Cookies and localStorage are origin-scoped, so a new port each launch = a new origin = all saved state discarded. Fixing the default to one constant makes the origin stable across launches.
- **Governing ADs:** AD-5 (Auth: Cognito JWT + CSRF, secure cookie) — the auth cookie must persist; AD-10 (Electron thin wrapper). FR-19 (Auth/session → `routes/auth/` + `plugins/`, client `auth/`).
- **Why a fixed port is safe here:** this is a local desktop app bound to `localhost`; there is no multi-instance or server-farm concern. The in-use fallback (AC #2) covers the rare collision without crashing.
- **Port choice rationale:** `7420` was picked because it collides with none of the ports already referenced across the codebase (3000, 4200, 4566, 8080). If a different free port is preferred, change only the constant — every AC keys off "a single fixed default," not the specific number.
- **Do NOT touch:** the `DMS_SMOKE_PORT` override path (`parseSmokePort`, `main.ts:232`) and the smoke spec's use of it — those must behave exactly as before (AC #3).
- **Testing standard:** Electron specs run under `nx test electron`. The red-phase un-skip-first convention applies: Task 1 removes Story 11.1's skips, confirms red, then Tasks 2–3 implement until green.

### Project Structure Notes

- Modify: `apps/electron/src/main.ts` — default port branch now returns the fixed constant with an in-use fallback; override path unchanged.
- Modify/extend: the Electron utils module from Story 11.1 (e.g. `resolve-app-port`) to hold `DEFAULT_APP_PORT` and the resolution logic.
- No conflict: change is localized to port resolution; CSP/navigation guards read the resolved `port`, so they follow automatically.
